question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the "mysteries" surrounding the sitter, which include her identity and her "________ look."
 
• **"Enigmatic"** means mysterious, **puzzling**, or **difficult to understand**. 
 
• Using "**enigmatic**" makes the painting sound more mysterious and interesting, adding to why the Mona Lisa is so famous.

Therefore, the correct answer is- "Enigmatic".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Dark" (Option 1)** generally refers to limited light or conveys a negative, ominous implication, which doesn’t specifically fit the context.
 
• **"Occult" (Option 2)** is associated with supernatural, magical, or mystical phenomena, which is not appropriate in describing the subtle naturalism and psychological complexity of the Mona Lisa's expression.
 
• **"Murky" (Option 4) **implies something that is cloudy, unclear, or difficult to see through physically, which misses the abstract and psychological nuance of the Mona Lisa’s intriguing expression.
